気力１４０以上で「怨嗟の魔蠍」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
suffer Armor Down.

気力１４０以上で「立ち上がる射手」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\n自機から１０マス.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$立ち上がる射手$$
activates: enemy teams within 10 tiles
deal x0.9 damage.

気力１４０以上で「知りたがる山羊」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\n自機から１０マス.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$知りたがる山羊$$
activates: enemy teams within 10 tiles
cannot activate their barriers.

気力１４０以上で「尽きぬ水瓶」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$
activates: at phase start, enemy teams within 10 tiles
do not recover EN.

気力１４０以上で「夢見る双魚」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$夢見る双魚$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
suffer Mobility Down.

気力１３０以上、ニュータイプＬ５以上で発動し、\\nデストロイモードに変形可能に.en:
Activates at Morale 130+ and Newtype Lv5+;
the unit can transform into Destroy Mode.

スフィア搭載機が持つ特殊な能力です。\\n気力１５０以上で発動し、効果はスフィア.en:
A special ability of Sphere-equipped mechs.
Activates at Morale 150+; effects vary by Sphere.

uncertain: Glossary token 尽きぬ水瓶 expands to 'Inexhaustible Water Gourd' (misspelling of 'Inexhaustible' in the glossary itself); used the token as is.
